reaction: I was curious about the rebuilding itself, so ending at preparation felt slightly abrupt.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding clotting proteins was most worthwhile because the fibrin mesh connected the platelet plug to a stronger temporary seal while making clear that sealing is not rebuilding.

leastWorthwhile.text: Applying the scrape was the least engaging step: it set up the situation but was the only available combination.

surprise.text: The cleanup cells both deal with debris and microbes and send signals that influence repair; defense and rebuilding can overlap.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary, although each decision offered only one combination, so I was following the available path rather than choosing between approaches.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because I want to see how the living skin barrier is rebuilt after the temporary seal and cleanup.
